title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Operations Manager (Liza Edtech)

  • Salary: R$10.000,00 - R$20.000,00
  • Location: 100% remote work. Possibility of in-person work in São Paulo in the future.
  • Type: Full-time


Who We Are & Our Story


Liza is a pioneering EdTech that uses Artificial Intelligence to transform pedagogical management and give time back to educators. Our company combines the operational rigor of the largest educational networks with innovation from Stanford.

  • Lisa Zhang (Founder): Experienced international founder, headquartered in Silicon Valley.
  • Fernando Cofiel (COO): Former COO of Maple Bear for 9 years, with extensive experience in operations scaling and franchising.
  • Rogério Luiz (CTO): PhD in Computer Science with a focus on AI.

We were born to give time back to teachers and deliver data intelligence to public and private administrators.


Who We’re Looking For


We are looking for a high-energy, execution-driven Operations Manager to help us build and scale our company. Someone with a strong startup mindset: fast-moving, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable solving problems in a dynamic environment. This person will work closely with leadership to manage projects, follow up on team execution, improve internal processes, and make sure work is delivered with speed, quality, and accountability.


What You’ll Do


As Senior Operations Manager, you will help keep the company running smoothly and make sure important projects move forward.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing internal projects from planning to execution
  • Following up with team members on task delivery and deadlines
  • Creating clear workflows, processes, and systems
  • Helping leadership track priorities, problems, and next steps
  • Identifying operational bottlenecks and solving them quickly
  • Supporting cross-functional work between sales, product, customer success, and leadership
  • Maintaining a high standard of execution across the team
  • Helping the company operate with more speed, structure, and accountability


The Person We Need


  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Fast-paced, proactive, and execution-focused
  • A quick learner who can adapt quickly
  • Strong at problem-solving and follow-through
  • Comfortable working under pressure
  • Good at project management and team coordination
  • Able to hold themselves and others to high standards
  • Energetic, positive, and easy to work with
  • Comfortable in a startup environment with changing priorities
  • Responsible, reliable, and ownership-driven


Ideal background


  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company
  • Experience in operations, project management, business operations, or executive support
  • Experience working with leadership teams or founders
  • Exposure to larger companies or more structured organizations is a plus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely with discipline and independence
  • Portuguese fluency required
  • English proficiency is a strong plus


Why join HiLiza


HiLiza is building an AI-native education platform designed to support public school systems, teachers, coordinators, and education leaders. This is an opportunity to join an early-stage company with strong growth potential and help build the operational foundation of the business from the ground up.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to be close to leadership, work on important company priorities, and grow with a startup.


How to apply


Please send your resume and a short message explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Include examples of projects, teams, or operations work you have managed before.

title: Analista de Performance

  • Acompanhamento diário dos indicadores de Vendas, Retenção e Recuperação.
  • Condução de reuniões estratégicas e de alinhamento com times de Produtos, EPS (BPO) e Gestão.
  • Gestão diária da performance da operação de Call Center focada em vendas (Ativo e Receptivo).

  • Realizar escutas ativas de ligações junto à Qualidade e EPS para identificar oportunidades de melhoria no pitch de vendas e no contorno de objeções.
  • Apoiar no desenho e no acompanhamento de campanhas de incentivo motivacionais para engajar os operadores e impulsionar a conversão.
  • Supervisionar atendimento de Vendas e Recuperação.
  • Promover dailys com parceiros a fim de definir a estratégia de atuação do dia e ter visibilidade da produtividade do dia anterior.



Habilidades Necessárias:



  • Experiência na áreas de vendas, com domínio em métricas de vendas, conversão e funil de vendas recorrentes.
  • Vivência em rotinas de Contact Center (Ativo e Receptivo).
  • Domínio de plataformas de atendimento, telefonia e CRM (Salesforce, Twilio, Avaya e sistemas DAC).
  • Sólido conhecimento em indicadores de performance com foco em Vendas, Retenção e Recuperação de clientes.
  • Pacote Office Avançado (Excel e PowerPoint) voltado para análise de dados, acompanhamento de indicadores e criação de apresentações gerenciais.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar e atuar simultaneamente em diferentes tarefas e processos.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade para interagir e engajar pares, outras áreas, parceiros e clientes.
  • Visão sistêmica de processos, perfil dinâmico e inteligência emocional para trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Perfil propositivo e analítico, capaz de identificar gargalos e trazer sugestões de melhoria para os processos de atendimento e vendas.
  • Foco em identificar oportunidades e trazer sugestões para otimização dos processos de atendimento e vendas.



Habilidades Preferenciais:


  • Experiência com operações de vendas, retenção e recuperação em ambientes de alta volumetria.
  • Vivência com acompanhamento de KPIs como Conversão, Recuperação, Custo Operacional e Forecast.
  • Experiência em gestão de performance de operações com múltiplas centrais e grande volume de atendimento.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.

title: Senior Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Workday Financials Consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the job


As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment.

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement scalable Workday Financials solutions aligned with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into system configurations.
  • Support ongoing enhancements, optimizations, and process improvements within Workday Financials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of financial system changes.
  • Contribute to backlog reduction and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with best practices.


What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills.
  • Proven experience across multiple Financials domains, especially: Financial Accounting (top priority), Expenses, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement (secondary)
  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Workday integrations and reporting is a plus.
  • Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

title: Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr.
description:

Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?


A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr. para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


  • Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado , mandatóriamente em PDF.
  • É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.
  • Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).
  • Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!


Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .


About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required


Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Operations Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Operations Manager (Liza Edtech)

  • Salary: R$10.000,00 - R$20.000,00
  • Location: 100% remote work. Possibility of in-person work in São Paulo in the future.
  • Type: Full-time


Who We Are & Our Story


Liza is a pioneering EdTech that uses Artificial Intelligence to transform pedagogical management and give time back to educators. Our company combines the operational rigor of the largest educational networks with innovation from Stanford.

  • Lisa Zhang (Founder): Experienced international founder, headquartered in Silicon Valley.
  • Fernando Cofiel (COO): Former COO of Maple Bear for 9 years, with extensive experience in operations scaling and franchising.
  • Rogério Luiz (CTO): PhD in Computer Science with a focus on AI.

We were born to give time back to teachers and deliver data intelligence to public and private administrators.


Who We’re Looking For


We are looking for a high-energy, execution-driven Operations Manager to help us build and scale our company. Someone with a strong startup mindset: fast-moving, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable solving problems in a dynamic environment. This person will work closely with leadership to manage projects, follow up on team execution, improve internal processes, and make sure work is delivered with speed, quality, and accountability.


What You’ll Do


As Senior Operations Manager, you will help keep the company running smoothly and make sure important projects move forward.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing internal projects from planning to execution
  • Following up with team members on task delivery and deadlines
  • Creating clear workflows, processes, and systems
  • Helping leadership track priorities, problems, and next steps
  • Identifying operational bottlenecks and solving them quickly
  • Supporting cross-functional work between sales, product, customer success, and leadership
  • Maintaining a high standard of execution across the team
  • Helping the company operate with more speed, structure, and accountability


The Person We Need


  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Fast-paced, proactive, and execution-focused
  • A quick learner who can adapt quickly
  • Strong at problem-solving and follow-through
  • Comfortable working under pressure
  • Good at project management and team coordination
  • Able to hold themselves and others to high standards
  • Energetic, positive, and easy to work with
  • Comfortable in a startup environment with changing priorities
  • Responsible, reliable, and ownership-driven


Ideal background


  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company
  • Experience in operations, project management, business operations, or executive support
  • Experience working with leadership teams or founders
  • Exposure to larger companies or more structured organizations is a plus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely with discipline and independence
  • Portuguese fluency required
  • English proficiency is a strong plus


Why join HiLiza


HiLiza is building an AI-native education platform designed to support public school systems, teachers, coordinators, and education leaders. This is an opportunity to join an early-stage company with strong growth potential and help build the operational foundation of the business from the ground up.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to be close to leadership, work on important company priorities, and grow with a startup.


How to apply


Please send your resume and a short message explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Include examples of projects, teams, or operations work you have managed before.

description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

description:

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM to lead recruitment strategies for technical positions across different countries in Latin America. This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.

  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React

We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.

How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Full Time

• Existing relationships with brokers or channel partners

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Estamos em um momento estratégico de growth, em que precisamos elevar a maturidade técnica do nosso B2B SaaS — com foco em segurança e compliance, redução de dívida técnica e escalabilidade de infraestrutura.

Você vai atuar como Engenheiro Sênior, com forte autonomia técnica, contribuindo diretamente em backend, infraestrutura/DevOps e segurança. Requisitos

✔ 5+ anos de experiência sólida com desenvolvimento backend em produção

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

  • Ensino superior completo;

  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;

  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Ser responsável por executar o processo mensal de billing, garantindo extração, tratamento e consistência dos dados, com forte atuação em automação de processos e rotinas (especialmente em Excel).


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Executar o ciclo mensal de billing (extração, validação e consolidação de dados);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em Databricks;
  • Construir e manter queries em SQL para geração de bases de faturamento;
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e reconciliação de dados;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e controles (principalmente em Excel);
  • Desenvolver e manter planilhas avançadas (macros, VBA, Power Query);
  • Garantir qualidade e integridade dos dados utilizados no billing;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais de suporte ao faturamento;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras para ajustes e validações;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de inconsistências.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Excel avançado (VBA, macros, Power Query);
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL;
  • Experiência prática com Databricks;
  • Experiência com automação de processos operacionais;
  • Experiência com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com billing / faturamento;
  • Conhecimento de processos financeiros;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI ou similar);
  • Noções de Python para automação.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools.
  • Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness.
  • Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards.

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cloud Architect Especialista para atuar em um time estratégico de alta maturidade técnica, com foco em modernização de aplicações, infraestrutura em nuvem AWS e práticas avançadas de DevOps.

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;
  • Garantir conformidade das soluções com o AWS Well-Architected Framework;
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos técnicos e não técnicos, apoiando decisões estratégicas de arquitetura;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança, governança e observabilidade;
  • Promover compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria técnica e apoio à evolução do time.


Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de atuação comprovada em CTPS;
  • Experiência sólida e aprofundada com AWS;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS CDK (Python), AWS CloudFormation e Terraform;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de esteiras CI/CD, containers, Git, boas práticas DevOps e padrões de segurança;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica para interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atividades

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Atuar com governança e compliance financeiro em nuvem.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Realizar análises detalhadas por serviço, região, produto, equipe ou centro de custo, mantendo rotinas contínuas de monitoramento de custos.

• Estruturar e manter modelos de rateio, garantindo associação correta de custos via tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras.

• Revisar taxonomias e sugerir melhorias de governança.

• Participar de reuniões de revisão de custos Azure com times de operações e liderança.

• Participar de comitês FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária.

• Mapear oportunidades de savings para construção de planos financeiros anuais.

• Criar previsões de uso e gastos utilizando dados históricos, identificando tendências e sazonalidade de consumo.

• Avaliar impacto financeiro de novos projetos ou workloads e apoiar análises de ROI de iniciativas Cloud.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em Microsoft Azure, incluindo infraestrutura, serviços e tecnologias da plataforma.

• Experiência com Governança em Azure, contemplando:

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.
